description: Create temp doc, draw rect, export SVG to Folder.temp, verify file exists, cleanup file and doc
source: var d = app.documents.add(); var outPath = Folder.temp + '/extmin-svg-' + (new Date()).getTime() + '.svg'; try { d.pathItems.rectangle(0,0,100,50); var opt = new ExportOptionsSVG(); d.exportFile(new File(outPath), ExportType.SVG, opt); var f = new File(outPath); return {exists: f.exists, size: f.length}; } finally { try { var g = new File(outPath); if (g.exists) { g.remove(); } } catch(e){} try { d.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES); } catch(e){} }
